visual.name: plumeWordCloud
visual.description: Word cloud with the Plume Studio look: words from a category or from long text split by the visual, built-in French and English stop words, size by a measure or by frequency, color by palette, by size or by a measure, 150+ shapes and your own SVG shape, horizontal, vertical or any angle range, 40+ Windows fonts, adjustable spacing; dense deterministic layout that never drops a word silently; two-word phrases, repeated words that fill the shape, period comparison and a play axis.
